description: This file contains implementation of bailout graph construction and bailout insertion logic for TorchScript JIT compiler, including classes and functions for building bailout graphs, replacing guards with bailout nodes, and managing bailout graph lifecycle.

classes.name: BailOutGraphBuilderForNode
classes.description: Class responsible for constructing bailout graphs from specific nodes, handling value mapping, cloning nodes, and building bailout blocks for control flow structures.

classes.name: BailOutInserter
classes.description: Class that replaces guard nodes with bailout nodes, embeds the original unoptimized graph, and manages bailout insertion and removal.

methods.name: addNewInputForValue
methods.description: Creates a new input in the bailout graph for a given value, reducing inputs for easier debugging.

methods.name: mapValueAndCopyMetadata
methods.description: Maps an old value to a new value in the bailout graph and copies metadata.

methods.name: getOrAddInputForValue
methods.description: Retrieves existing or adds new input for a value in the bailout graph.

methods.name: cloneNode
methods.description: Clones a node into the bailout graph, mapping outputs accordingly.

methods.name: buildBailOutBlockFrom
methods.description: Builds a bailout subgraph from a node until the end of its owning block, handling control flow structures.

methods.name: buildBailOutGraphFrom
methods.description: Constructs a bailout graph starting from a node, including inputs and outputs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the bailout insertion process: builds liveness sets, inserts bailout nodes, replaces guards, and embeds the unoptimized graph.

methods.name: addUnoptimizedFuncToBailouts
methods.description: Embeds the original unoptimized graph into bailout nodes as a constant subgraph.

methods.name: removeGuards
methods.description: Removes guard nodes and hooks up guarded tensors directly to their uses.

methods.name: replaceGuardsWithBailouts
methods.description: Replaces guard nodes with corresponding bailout nodes.

methods.name: insertBailOuts
methods.description: Inserts bailout nodes at guard points, capturing live inputs.

methods.name: locateBailOutNodeInUnoptimizedGraph
methods.description: Locates a bailout or guard node in a graph by bailout index.

methods.name: removeBailouts
methods.description: Removes bailout and guard nodes, hooking guarded inputs directly to their uses.
